events.body:
Steps: 1) Signed in and email-verified, open https://app.forkmesh.com/microjobs. 2) Click "Submit an issue" under "Report a useful, genuinely new issue" (href /forkmesh/forkmesh/issues/new). 3) Browser ends up at /forkmesh/forkmesh/issues showing the issue list (only #736) with no form open.

Expected: the new-issue form (title/description) opens directly, since the page says to use the ordinary issue form.
Actual: user must notice and click the separate "New issue" button; the form only appears after that.

Also observed: https://app.forkmesh.com/login while already signed in still shows the full "Welcome back" form (header shows signed-in user) instead of redirecting to the dashboard. Separate minor UX issue.
events.title: /microjobs "Submit an issue" link (/issues/new) lands on the issue list instead of the new-issue form
